scenarios.description: Measure a real apparent inspect on synthetic bundles with independent text and image verification.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Run apparent inspect /absolute/capture.apparent and read its summary and referenced evidence.
prerequisites: Unstripped native release builds, Node 22, Bun, FFmpeg, GNU Time, Git, nm and permission to run bpftrace locally.
An uncontended CPU and SMT sibling, and a private job for retained or demo-generated synthetic bundles.
expectedEvidence: Raw paired waits, normalized score, source and binary identities, probe overhead, resource use and a machine-readable stop decision.
Verified timed narration, decodable PNG evidence, immutable bundle bytes and a monotonic trace per diagnostic attempt.
limits: Only the shared manual GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 workflow qualifies campaign scores. Local replay is diagnostic. Packaged extraction, native capture, macOS and remote sources have separate checks.

scenarios.description: Calibrate Agent local inspection on a standard GitHub-hosted runner.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Dispatch the shared performance workflow for Agent with equal reviewed control and candidate SHAs.
prerequisites: Standard ubuntu-24.04 runner and the shared manual performance workflow on main.
Full detached checkouts, Node 22.23.0 and the owner adapter's Ubuntu and native tool prerequisites.
expectedEvidence: CPU quota and topology receipt, rejected injected load, and quiet same-build A/A/A/A score of 100 with raw repeat variation.
The receipt preserves verified synthetic output, CPU, RSS, storage and native trace waterfalls. Distinct revisions additionally produce matched A/B/B/A waits.
limits: Counters describe guest-visible CPUs and their visible siblings. The lane covers explicit local inspect rather than packaged extraction or remote providers.

scenarios.description: Render and review a private established example with one timed narration track.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Run apparent video narrator, then apparent video inspect and apparent video render on local synthetic evidence.
prerequisites: A development Apparent CLI, FFmpeg with libass and drawtext, ffprobe, a provisioned local Apparent narrator, and a private scratch directory.
expectedEvidence: Timestamped source contact sheets, an editable plan and captions, a decodable 30 fps MP4 with one mono stream and Kokoro voice metadata, and a timestamped review sheet.
limits: The proof runner checks the plan policy. Inspect and render are supplemented by a CLI replay on Linux. Existing source footage supplies the app behavior. The CLI replay does not open a native capture surface.
